description: Example: the buddie gate for sessions that send their results through tools other than SendMessage (a project's reply and post tools, cloud sessions). The plugin's hooks/hooks.json matches only SendMessage, Agent and Task; merge these PreToolUse entries into ~/.claude/settings.json or the project's .claude/settings.json and rename the tools to yours. `buddie hook` needs `pip install`; from a clone use `python3 /path/to/buddie/run.py hook`. A project that hands in results through a tool names the mark of its final answer as final_mark in buddie.toml [mandate] (or BUDDIE_FINAL); without one the final answer is the last message at Stop. The PostToolUse entry writes a project's decision card (ask_decision) to the journal at once, so `choice:<card id>=<step>` can be checked after the session that asked is gone; the pick itself is read from the transcript of the session it reaches.
